name: Sumida Sangyo Kaikan Sunrise Hall
address: Tokyo 130-0022 8F and 9F, Sumida Ward-Marui Joint Development Building, 3-9-10 Koto-bashi, Sumida-ku
accessSummary: Kinshicho Station (JR), South Exit: 1 min walk / Kinshicho Station (Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line), Exit 1: 1 min walk
hours: Open 9:00-21:00 (reservations and counter reception 9:00-20:00). Closed only for the year-end and New Year holidays (December 29 to January 3). The time slots are morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-16:30 / evening 17:30-21:00, and you can add an early-morning extension 8:00-9:00 and an evening extension 21:00-22:00 (an extension cannot be booked on its own). The halls can also add 7:00-8:00 (paid). Entry is allowed from 15 minutes before the reserved time for the halls and 5 minutes before for the conference rooms.
notice: Groups from outside Sumida Ward can also rent the venue, but it cannot be rented under an individual's name; use a group name such as a company or circle name. For first-time use, visit in person to register your group in the Sumida Ward public facility reservation system (the representative's ID is required). Fees are higher for groups from outside the ward than for those inside it. Parties, drinking and on-the-spot sales are not allowed in the conference rooms.

rooms.name: Hall A (8F)
rooms.note: 122 desks and 366 chairs (3 chairs per desk). 600 chairs if chairs only. Maximum capacity 800. The exhibition room (Sunrise Hall) is up to 1,200㎡ and can be changed into 4 types, A to D.

rooms.name: Hall B (8F)
rooms.note: 102 desks and 306 chairs (3 chairs per desk). 500 chairs if chairs only. Maximum capacity 600. Example training/meeting layout using Hall B: 120 people, 2 per desk.

rooms.name: Hall C (8F)
rooms.note: 72 desks and 216 chairs (3 chairs per desk). 350 chairs if chairs only. Maximum capacity 400.

rooms.name: Hall D (8F)
rooms.note: 36 desks and 108 chairs (3 chairs per desk). 120 chairs if chairs only. Maximum capacity 130. About 21 m wide x 12 m deep (Type D floor plan). Comes with a movable screen (free) and 2 wireless microphones (paid).

rooms.name: Conference Room 3 (9F)
rooms.note: Capacity 24 to 39. Public address system available.

rooms.name: Conference Room 4 (9F)
rooms.note: Capacity 65. Public address system available. Comes with a 120-inch screen.

ops.loadingHours: Vehicles can enter the B2F loading area from 7:30. When carrying items by hand truck or similar, use the freight elevator from the 1F disaster prevention center or the B2F loading area (only Elevator No. 5 for the halls and Elevator No. 8 for the conference rooms). Elevator No. 5 is limited to 2.3 m wide x 2.4 m deep x 2.55 m high, and Elevator No. 8 to 1.8 m wide x 1.85 m deep x 2.3 m high. Submit the load-in/load-out notice up to 30 days before the use date (at the latest 2 weeks before); fax is also accepted. If you want to reserve an elevator for exclusive use, request it by the time you submit the load-in/load-out notice one week before the use date (because it is shared with Kinshicho Marui, it may not go as requested). 20 cage carts and 9 hand trucks can be borrowed free of charge. The FAQ page also states that the notice deadline is "up to 1 week before the use date."
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles enter the B2F loading area from the entrance on the right side of the front of Kinshicho Marui and check in at the Marui disaster prevention center. Place the sticker on the dashboard and follow the staff's instructions. Vehicles may stay for up to 30 minutes. When there are 10 or more vehicles, traffic staff are placed at the B2F loading area and the 1F parking lot entrance. Vehicles that can enter are up to 2.9 m in height as shown on the vehicle inspection certificate (3 m when empty), up to 2-ton long-size trucks and 4-ton flatbed trucks. Using hand trucks in the store elevators and the see-through elevator, and carrying cardboard boxes by hand, are prohibited.
ops.parking: There is no dedicated parking lot. Use the Kinshicho Marui parking lot (10:30-23:00) or a nearby parking lot. The parking discounts of Marui and Kinshicho Park Tower cannot be used for using this facility. Only when the organizer comes to pay the usage fee, parking at the Marui lot is free for 1 hour. There is also no dedicated bicycle parking; use the Marui bicycle parking (6:30-24:00). Bicycles are free for up to 2 hours, then 100 yen every 2 hours.
ops.catering: Catering, boxed meals and coffee cannot be arranged by the facility, and vendors are not introduced. Vendors that users often use and that are mentioned are Party Service OMURAI, CB Service Co., Ltd., and Restaurant Muromachi. Food and drink including alcohol, such as at parties and receptions, is allowed in the halls, and food and drink may be sold only as individually packaged items. Cooking in the halls requires an application to Sumida Ward and a notification to and approval from the Sumida Public Health Center. Eating and drinking is allowed in the conference rooms but bringing in alcohol is not, so hold parties and receptions in the halls. When a boxed meal vendor delivers, a load-in/load-out notice is required. There are no trash cans; take all trash home.
ops.restaurants: The same building (Kinshicho Marui) has a restaurant floor on the 7th floor and Thali-ya Cafe Kinshicho (Indian set meals) on the 8th floor. For coffee, Cafe de Crie Plus in the building and Komeda's Coffee on the 2nd floor are mentioned. Boxed meals can be ordered from Thali-ya on the 8th floor and Ootoya on the 7th floor.
